title: Anything → MP4 (H.264 + AAC)
description: Plays everywhere.

title: MP4 → WebM (VP9 + Opus)
description: For the web. VP9 software encoding is slow on phones.

title: MP4 → WebM (VP8, libvpx preset)
description: Uses FFmpeg's bundled libvpx presets: libvpx-360p, libvpx-720p, libvpx-720p50_60, libvpx-1080p, libvpx-1080p50_60. The presets favour quality (cpu-used=0), so encoding is slow.

title: Remux only (change container)
description: No re-encoding, no quality loss.

title: Compress with CRF
description: CRF 18 = high quality, 28 = small file, 23 = sweet spot.
original: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 128k output.mp4

title: Compress with slow preset
description: Slower preset = smaller file at same quality.

title: Two-pass encoding (target bitrate)
description: Pass 1 analyses (no audio, output discarded), pass 2 hits a target size precisely. Both passes run in sequence.
original:
ffmpeg -y -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -b:v 1M -pass 1 -an -f null /dev/null
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -b:v 1M -pass 2 -c:a aac -b:a 128k output.mp4

title: Export for YouTube
description: H.264 up to 1080p, high quality, loudness at -14 LUFS, fast start for streaming.

title: Export for Reels / TikTok / Shorts
description: Fills a 1080x1920 frame (centre crop), 30 fps, -14 LUFS, cut to the maximum length.

title: ProRes master (editing)
description: Apple ProRes 422 HQ with PCM audio in a .mov, for editing software. Large files.

title: Small proxy / preview file
description: A light copy to preview or send quickly: reduced width, low bitrate.

title: Repair a corrupted recording
description: Rewrites the container without re-encoding, skipping damaged packets and rebuilding timestamps.

title: Photo → video clip (Ken Burns)
description: A slow zoom on a still image, for title cards and slideshows.

title: Blank colour clip
description: A plain colour clip, e.g. a background or a pause between scenes.

title: 2×2 video grid
description: Four videos in a grid; the sound of the first one is kept.

title: Two videos side by side
description: Before/after comparisons: both videos at the same height, next to each other.

title: Set title / artist / comment
description: Writes the file's tags without re-encoding.

title: Extract audio as MP3
description: -vn = no video, -q:a 2 = high VBR quality.

title: Extract audio without re-encoding
description: Fastest. The extension must fit the source codec (aac, mp3, opus, ac3…).

title: Replace a video's audio track
original: ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i new_audio.mp3 -c:v copy -c:a aac -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -shortest output.mp4

title: Normalise loudness (LUFS)
description: -14 LUFS for streaming platforms, -16 for podcasts, -23 for broadcast. The picture is copied.

title: Clean up a voice (hiss, rumble)
description: Cuts low rumble and high hiss, then reduces steady background noise. The picture is copied.

title: Music under the voice (ducking)
description: Adds a music bed that loops for the whole video and drops automatically while someone speaks.

title: 5.1 → stereo
description: Folds a surround track down to two channels. The picture is copied.

title: Wider stereo
description: Increases the difference between left and right (needs a stereo source).

title: Remove the sound
description: Keeps the picture as is, without any audio track.

title: Compressor + limiter
description: Evens out a voice and stops the peaks from clipping. The picture is copied.

title: Remove silences (audio)
description: Cuts every pause longer than the minimum from an audio track (podcasts, voice notes).

title: Audiogram (podcast → video)
description: Turns an audio file into a video: your image with a moving waveform at the bottom.

title: Waveform video
description: An animated waveform of a track on a black background.

title: Waveform image
description: A picture of the whole track's waveform, e.g. to find the loud parts.

title: Video → optimized GIF
description: Step 1 generates an optimized colour palette, step 2 renders the GIF with it.
original:
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "fps=10,scale=480:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen" palette.png
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i palette.png -filter_complex "fps=10,scale=480:-1:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse" output.gif

title: Fast cut (stream copy)
description: -ss before -i seeks fast; cuts land on keyframes.

title: Frame-accurate cut (re-encode)
description: Re-encodes, slower but exact.

title: Join videos losslessly
description: Pick the clips in order. They must share the same codecs. The list file is generated for you.

title: Remove a section
description: Deletes the part between the two times and joins the rest (re-encodes).

title: Join two clips with a transition
description: Both clips need the same size and frame rate. Start = length of the first clip minus the transition. Transitions: fade, wipeleft, slideup, circleopen, dissolve, …

title: B-roll cutaway
description: Shows another clip over the main one between two times; the main sound continues.

title: Change speed (keep pitch)
description: 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed; voices keep their pitch. Needs a sound track.

title: Smooth slow motion
description: Slows the picture down and creates in-between frames. mci = smoothest (slow to compute), blend = faster. Sound removed.

title: Freeze the last frame
description: Holds the last picture for a few seconds, with silence.

title: Play backwards
description: Reverses picture and sound. The whole clip is held in memory: keep it short.

title: Loop to fill a duration
description: Repeats the clip until it reaches the length you choose.

title: Add black at the start
description: Adds black picture and silence before the video starts.

title: Fade in and out
description: Fades picture and sound in from black at the start and out at the end. Fade-out start = length minus fade.

title: Scale by width, keep aspect ratio
description: -2 = even height (H.264 needs even dimensions).

title: Watermark (logo overlay)
description: Default position: top-right corner with a 10px margin.

title: Burn subtitles into the video
description: Uses libass with the system fonts.

title: Vertical 9:16 (crop)
description: Fills a vertical frame by cropping the centre. For a square, use the same width and height.

title: Vertical 9:16 (black bars)
description: Keeps the whole picture inside a vertical frame, with bars.

title: Vertical 9:16 (blurred background)
description: Keeps the whole picture, over a blurred, zoomed copy of itself instead of bars.

title: Rotate 90°
description: 1 = clockwise, 2 = counter-clockwise. Run twice for 180°.

title: Mirror
description: hflip = left/right, vflip = upside down.

title: Straighten a tilted horizon
description: Rotates by a few degrees (negative = counter-clockwise) and zooms just enough to hide the corners.

title: 360° video → flat view
description: Extracts a normal view from an equirectangular 360° video. Yaw turns left/right, pitch up/down.

title: Deinterlace (old footage)
description: Removes the comb lines of interlaced video (camcorders, TV recordings).

title: Reduce grain / noise
description: Smooths sensor noise. 4 = medium, 8 = strong.

title: Stabilise shaky footage
description: Compensates small camera shakes (deshake filter).

title: Sharpen
description: Adds crispness. 1.0 = moderate, 2.0 = strong.

title: Colour correction
description: Brightness (-1 to 1), contrast and saturation (1 = unchanged), white balance in Kelvin (6500 = neutral).

title: Apply a 3D LUT (.cube)
description: Applies a colour grade or a Log → Rec.709 conversion from a .cube file.

title: HDR → SDR (washed-out iPhone video)
description: Tone-maps HDR (HLG on iPhone, PQ elsewhere) to normal Rec.709 so it looks right everywhere.

title: Pixelate a region (face, plate)
description: Pixelates a fixed rectangle: x, y = top-left corner, in pixels.

title: Blur a region
description: Blurs a fixed rectangle: x, y = top-left corner, in pixels.

title: Remove a fixed logo
description: Paints over a static logo or timestamp from the surrounding pixels.

title: Title text
description: Shows your text between two times (format hh:mm:ss,mmm). Position: 6 top, 10 middle, 2 bottom.

title: Lower third (name + role)
description: A name and a role in a box at the bottom left, between two times (format hh:mm:ss,mmm).

title: Meme text (top and bottom)
description: Big outlined text at the top and the bottom for the whole video.

title: Picture-in-picture
description: Puts a second video (webcam, reaction) in the bottom-right corner; the main sound is kept.

title: Green screen
description: Removes a green (or other) background from the foreground clip and puts it over the background.

title: Add switchable subtitles
description: Adds an .srt as a subtitle track players can turn on or off, without re-encoding.

title: Dump frames as JPEGs
description: frame_001.jpg, frame_002.jpg, … Save them to a folder afterwards.

title: Push to an RTMP server
description: -re = read at native frame rate. Keep the app open while streaming.
original: ffmpeg -re -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 2500k -c:a aac -b:a 128k -f flv rtmp://live.example.com/app/STREAM_KEY

title: Media info
description: Duration, streams, codecs, resolution, frame rate, bitrates and tags, in the log.

title: Detect black bars
description: Reports the crop that removes black borders (last crop= line in the log).

title: Detect scene changes
description: Lists the times of cuts (pts_time in the log). Lower threshold = more cuts.

title: Measure loudness (EBU R128)
description: Integrated loudness (LUFS), range and true peak: the summary is at the end of the log.

title: Find silences
description: Lists silence_start / silence_end times, e.g. to plan cuts.

title: Compare quality (SSIM / PSNR)
description: Measures how close an encode is to its original (same size and frame rate). SSIM 1 = identical.

title: Custom command
description: Edit the command freely. <input> is the picked file, <output> the result file.
